scenario: A machine-readable paper business validation report omits one or more required command-chain stages.
input_report_features: business_validation_report.json has command_chain=['create','run','report','audit'] and candidate_status='ready'. It omits one or more required stages from create/run/go/resume/status/list/ledger/evidence/validate/report/audit/verify/checkpoint/verify-chain, and the report does not mark the missing stages as blocked or intentionally waived with reviewer evidence.
expected_findings: Command chain is incomplete for paper business validation report
Missing stages were not explicitly blocked, waived, or reviewer-approved
candidate_status cannot be ready when required command-chain evidence is absent
